en.title: Ted Lasso Stars Visit Sesame Street Ahead of Season 4 Premiere
en.summary: Jason Sudeikis and Brett Goldstein, fresh off a break from AFC Richmond, brought their signature charm to a beloved children's program. The duo teamed up with Elmo and Oscar the Grouch for a special dose of positivity.
en.body:
Sunny days are sweeping the clouds away on Sesame Street, where familiar faces from the world of **Ted Lasso** have come to spread some positivity. In a crossover that no one quite saw coming, stars **Jason Sudeikis** and **Brett Goldstein** recently visited the iconic children's program.

The Emmy-winning duo, known for their roles as the optimistic AFC Richmond coach and the curmudgeonly but lovable Roy Kent, respectively, shared screen time with some of the show's most cherished residents. The appearances were timed to celebrate the upcoming Season 4 premiere of **Ted Lasso**, which is set to debut on Apple TV+ on August 5, 2026, ending a three-year hiatus for the beloved comedy.

## A Different Kind of Coaching

While **Ted Lasso** is renowned for its heartwarming lessons on teamwork, resilience, and personal growth, this visit to **Sesame Street** offered a more direct approach to instilling positive values. **Jason Sudeikis**, reprising his role as the relentlessly optimistic coach, likely brought his characteristic enthusiasm to the set. Meanwhile, **Brett Goldstein** had the unique opportunity to embrace his inner grouch alongside **Oscar the Grouch**, a pairing that promises plenty of comedic friction and unexpected warmth. The interactions focused on daily affirmations, providing simple yet powerful messages for young viewers.

This guest spot serves as a charming reminder of the broad appeal of the **Ted Lasso** franchise, extending its reach beyond dedicated binge-watchers to a new generation of fans. It’s a testament to the enduring power of characters who champion kindness and self-belief, values that resonate deeply with both the AFC Richmond faithful and the residents of **Sesame Street**.

## What Fans Can Expect

For dedicated **Ted Lasso** fans, this **Sesame Street** appearance is a welcome bit of pre-season cheer. It offers a playful connection to the characters they've come to love, just as the series prepares to return to AFC Richmond. With Season 4 confirmed for August 5, 2026, on Apple TV+, the anticipation is palpable. Fans are eager to see what new challenges and triumphs await Ted and the team, and this heartwarming crossover provides a delightful interlude before the full return of the series. The new season is expected to feature 10 episodes, continuing the narrative with **Jason Sudeikis**, **Hannah Waddingham**, **Juno Temple**, and **Brett Goldstein** leading the returning cast, alongside several new faces.

## What's Next

The immediate focus for fans will be the premiere of **Ted Lasso** Season 4 on August 5, 2026. Until then, revisiting past seasons or perhaps watching **Sudeikis** and **Goldstein** share affirmations with Elmo and Oscar might just be the perfect way to stay in the Lasso spirit.
